<defs>
  <radialGradient id="gWater" cx="0.46" cy="0.42" r="0.62">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.1"/>
    <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#A9CBFA" stop-opacity="0.34"/>
    <stop offset="0.8" stop-color="#3A71E6" stop-opacity="0.84"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#1B4FD8" stop-opacity="0.97"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <linearGradient id="gRefr" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.15"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
  </linearGradient>
  <radialGradient id="gHi" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.95"/>
    <stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0.4"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="gCaustic" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFFFFF" stop-opacity="1"/>
    <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#E4EEFF" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#E4EEFF" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <radialGradient id="gShadow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
    <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0E1B33" stop-opacity="0.26"/>
    <stop offset="1" stop-color="#0E1B33" stop-opacity="0"/>
  </radialGradient>
  <clipPath id="cOut"><path clip-rule="evenodd" d="M0 0H220V220H0Z M110 48A72 72 0 1 0 110 192A72 72 0 1 0 110 48Z"/></clipPath>
  <clipPath id="cDef"><path d="M110 48C144.2 48 172 80.2 172 120C172 159.8 144.2 192 110 192C70.2 192 38 159.8 38 120C38 80.2 70.2 48 110 48Z"/></clipPath>

  <!-- full-size water drop -->
  <g id="bubble">
    <circle cx="110" cy="120" r="72" fill="url(#gWater)"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="120" r="66" fill="none" stroke="#1B4FD8" stroke-opacity="0.08" stroke-width="6"/>
    <path d="M171.2 95.3A66 66 0 1 1 48.8 95.3A64 64 0 1 0 171.2 95.3Z" fill="url(#gRefr)"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="120" r="72" fill="none" stroke="#1B4FD8" stroke-opacity="0.6" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="86" cy="84" rx="24" ry="14" transform="rotate(-36 86 84)" fill="url(#gHi)"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="3.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- the same drop, slightly deflated on its right side (Qualcosa non va) -->
  <g id="bubbleDef">
    <path d="M110 48C144.2 48 172 80.2 172 120C172 159.8 144.2 192 110 192C70.2 192 38 159.8 38 120C38 80.2 70.2 48 110 48Z" fill="url(#gWater)"/>
    <path d="M171.2 95.3A66 66 0 1 1 48.8 95.3A64 64 0 1 0 171.2 95.3Z" fill="url(#gRefr)" clip-path="url(#cDef)"/>
    <path d="M110 48C144.2 48 172 80.2 172 120C172 159.8 144.2 192 110 192C70.2 192 38 159.8 38 120C38 80.2 70.2 48 110 48Z" fill="none" stroke="#1B4FD8" stroke-opacity="0.6" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="86" cy="84" rx="24" ry="14" transform="rotate(-36 86 84)" fill="url(#gHi)"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="3.6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 32 px body: heavier rim, one highlight, no refraction detail -->
  <g id="bubbleS">
    <circle cx="110" cy="120" r="74" fill="url(#gWater)"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="120" r="74" fill="none" stroke="#1B4FD8" stroke-width="7" stroke-opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="82" cy="82" r="9" fill="#FFFFFF" fill-opacity="0.85"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 32 px simplified faces: thick eyes and mouth, no accessories -->
  <g id="s-felice">
    <use href="#bubbleS"/>
    <path d="M74 122Q88 100 102 122M118 122Q132 100 146 122" fill="none" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M84 140Q110 176 136 140Z" fill="#0E1B33" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="6" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>
  <g id="s-concentrato">
    <use href="#bubbleS"/>
    <path d="M71 101H101M119 101H149" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <ellipse cx="88" cy="120" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#0E1B33"/>
    <ellipse cx="132" cy="120" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#0E1B33"/>
    <circle cx="92" cy="116" r="3" fill="#F6F8FB"/>
    <circle cx="136" cy="116" r="3" fill="#F6F8FB"/>
    <path d="M101 148Q110 151 119 147" fill="none" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g id="s-fatto">
    <use href="#bubbleS"/>
    <path d="M72 124Q88 98 104 124" fill="none" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="134" cy="116" r="13" fill="#0E1B33"/>
    <path d="M90 138Q110 160 130 138" fill="none" stroke="#0E1B33" stroke-width="13" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <g id="s-errore">
    <use href="#bubbleS"/>
    <circle cx="86" cy="116" r="16" fill="#0E1B33"/>
    <circle cx="134" cy="118" r="10.5" fill="#0E1B33"/>
    <ellipse cx="112" cy="150" rx="9" ry="10.5" fill="#0E1B33"/>
  </g>
</defs>
